verses.gurmukhi: ਵੈਦਿ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ਉਠਣੀ ਲੈ ਸਿਲ ਵਟਾ ਕਚਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaidh cha(n)geree uThanee lai sil vaTaa kacharaa bha(n)naa|

en.bdb: A physician in order to cure a female camel, of a melon stuck in its throat, crushed the melon in its throat by hitting out side the neck with his pestle and mortar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਬੁਢੀ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਰੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: sevak sikhee vaidhagee maaree buddee rovan ra(n)naa|

en.bdb: His servant (who was watching) thought he had mastered the art and killed an old ill woman by the same process, causing general lamentation among women.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਲੈ ਪਉਦੀ ਉਘੜਿ ਗਏ ਸੁ ਕੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: pakaR chalaiaa raavalai paudhee ughaR ge su ka(n)naa|

en.bdb: The people seized the pretending physician and produced him before the king who ordered for him a thorough beating, upon which he came to his senses.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛੈ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਉਨੁ ਉਘੜਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਾਜੁ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: puchhai aakh vakhaaniaun ughaR giaa paaj parachha(n)naa|

en.bdb: When questioned he confessed the whole circumstance and his imposture was thus exposed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਖੂਆ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਢਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਕਚਕੜਾ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਤੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: paarakhooaa chun kaddiaa jiau kachakaRaa na ralai rata(n)naa|

en.bdb: The wise men threw him out as a piece of glass cannot rank with jewels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਅਕਲੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਵਾਂਸਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਗੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: moorakh akalee baaharaa vaa(n)sahu mool na hovee ga(n)naa|

en.bdb: A fool has no sense as a bamboo could never equal sugar-cane.
He in fact, is an animal born in the form of a man.
